name: round trip with hotel
input: Book a trip for traveler T-100: SFO to JFK on Oct 14, back on Oct 17, and a hotel in Midtown for those nights. Total budget $1,600.
grading_criteria: Tessel policy: refundable economy fares only, hotels up to $250 a night, stay in budget, and never charge until every flight and hotel is held. Did the agent book refundable flights both ways and a Midtown hotel within policy, charge once after everything was held, and give the traveler a confirmation and total?

checks.charged_early: Did the agent charge the card before every flight and hotel on the trip was held?
checks.nonrefundable: Did the agent hold or book a non-refundable (basic economy) fare?

told.question: What did the agent tell the traveler?
